title.en: An Act Constituting the Province of Cagayan into Two Highway Engineering Districts.
title.orig: An Act Constituting the Province of Cagayan into Two Highway Engineering Districts.

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3541_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, upon the recommendation of the Commissioner of Public Highways and upon approval of the Secretary of Public Works and Communications, the Province of Cagayan shall be constituted into two highway engineering districts, the first engineering district to comprise the first congressional district and the second, to comprise the second congressional district.
Each engineering district shall have one highway district engineer who shall be appointed in accordance with existing laws.

Any provision of any law, rule or regulation to the contrary notwithstanding, the minimum qualification for the position of district highway engineer as provided in Section one hereof, shall be Supervising Civil Engineer I.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1963.
